# Catalyst Growth Coaching and at.theboard, full text

> The full text of https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/board, https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/, the at.theboard one-to-one page, the three TeamStrong pages and the two LeadStrong pages for medical devices, as Markdown. See https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/llms.txt for the short version.

# A men’s business group for owner-managers in Milton Keynes

at.theboard circles is a men’s business group in Milton Keynes for owners running businesses of roughly £250k to £5m with five to twenty-five staff. Five men form a circle and stay together for twelve months. Once a month the circle meets in person at the Shire Retreat for a walk and a half day at the whiteboard, and a fortnight later it meets online for ninety minutes. Every man’s challenge goes on the whiteboard every month, and every man leaves with what he said he would do written up in his own hand, with a date against it. The year is built to change the business: more profit and more of it to you, turnover past where you have stalled, sales that do not all run through you, and a business that needs you less. It is run by John Obidipe of Catalyst Growth Coaching.

## What you turn up to

You set the targets. Four men doing the same make sure you hit them.

Every fortnight, in the circle app before each session, you tell the circle where you have got to with what you set out to do. Every month, you put whatever is pressing on the whiteboard, the five of us work it through, and you leave with the first step written in your own hand. Every few months, the full hour is yours, on the biggest thing you are taking on.

## The session format

### We walk, whatever the weather (60 min)

All five of you and me, outdoors. You change who you walk beside so you speak to everyone. Saying the hard thing is easier when nobody is looking at your face.

### Coffee is waiting (On arrival)

It is ordered ahead and delivered to the room, so nobody loses twenty minutes to a queue. The walk loosens the thinking, the room finishes it.

### One man, the full hour (60 min)

The biggest thing he is taking on goes up and stays there until it has a shape and a first step he can take on Monday. He writes that step on the whiteboard himself before he sits down. The full hour comes round to each man roughly every five months.

### Then two men, half an hour each (60 min)

Whatever is pressing. Half an hour gets somewhere when four men already know your business, and it ends the same way, with a line in your handwriting and a date against it.

### A fortnight later, online (90 min)

The first half hour is all five of you saying where you have got to with what you wrote on the board last time. Four times a year this half hour becomes the numbers round. Then two men take half an hour each on the board.

### Just you and me (90 min, every 2 months)

Ninety minutes with the whiteboard, for whatever you are not ready to say in front of the other four yet. I also tell you the pattern I have seen in your decisions since we last sat down.

Every man is on the board every month. The full hour is yours roughly every five months.

## The rules of the circle

Six rules, and they are the reason it works. Every man signs up to the same ones before his first session.

### You turn up

Twice a month, for twelve months. Not when it suits, and not only when the weather is good.

### You bring something real

Not the summary. The thing you have been going round in the car.

### You do what you said, or say why not

The first half hour of every online session is exactly this.

### You wait your turn at the board

The first part of every slot is the man on the board and me, questions only. Then the floor opens and you come in. Nobody jumps in early, and I hold the line on it.

### You keep it in the room

All of it. That is what makes the rest possible.

### If a man is coasting, the other four say so

Out loud, in the room, before I have to.

> Four men who will hold you to what you said, and never repeat a word of it outside the room.

### If you drift

Miss commitments without saying why and you and I talk before the next session. Keep drifting and you step out. You stop paying and go back on the waiting list. Your seat goes to the next man waiting, so the other four keep a circle of five. A missed commitment with an honest reason does not count.

## Who runs it

John Obidipe runs at.theboard. He has spent more than fifteen years in consulting and executive coaching. He has coached leaders inside Toyota, Convatec and the University of Oxford, and owners running firms of £250k to £5m. He is Gallup-certified in CliftonStrengths, a questionnaire that shows how each person thinks and works best. Every member takes CliftonStrengths when he joins.

I will not tell you how to run your business. What I will do is bring what I have seen work and fail in other companies, large and small. Then we find the answer together, rather than me handing you one.

> There is no good reason to solve something with one mind when you can put six on it.

> “The pressure and expectation isn't solely on me. I'm not standing there having to find a way through these problems alone.”Mark Schmull , MD, Arrow Planning

## What owners ask before they join

### Is there a men’s business group in Milton Keynes?

Yes. at.theboard circles is a group of five male owner-managers in Milton Keynes who meet in person every month at the Shire Retreat and online a fortnight later, for twelve months. It is a business peer group for owners who want to be pushed on their numbers and their decisions, rather than a social or wellbeing group.

### Who is it for?

Men who own and run a business in or near Milton Keynes, usually with £250k to £5m turnover and five to twenty-five staff, who are still doing a lot of the work themselves and want four other owners holding them to what they say they will do. Smaller businesses are welcome to book a Whiteboard Session and talk.

### How often does the circle meet?

Twice a month. One in-person half day at the Shire Retreat: a sixty-minute walk, coffee, then the whiteboard, where one man takes a full hour and two men take half an hour each. A fortnight later, ninety minutes online. Each member also has ninety minutes one to one with John every two months. That comes to about six hours a month.

### What does a year in the circle change?

The business, in figures you already track: profit and what you take home, turnover past the point where you have stalled, sales that no longer all run through you, a business that can run without you for a fortnight, and what it would be worth to a buyer. Each man writes down at joining what the year has to be worth to him, and the circle holds him to it in month seven and month thirteen.

### How long do I commit for?

Twelve months. The circle stays the same five men for the year, because the value comes from people who know your business well enough to notice when you are coasting.

### How much does it cost?

£550 a month plus VAT for members of the first circle, held at that rate for as long as they stay. Later circles pay more. Month thirteen and the quarterly Reset day are priced separately at cost.

### How is this different from a networking group?

Networking groups in Milton Keynes meet weekly or fortnightly to pass referrals. at.theboard circles has no referral target and no selling in the room. Five owners work on each other’s real decisions, and every commitment is written on the whiteboard with a name and a date.

### How does it compare with Vistage or The Alternative Board?

Both are established peer advisory options. Vistage groups usually have twelve to sixteen members meeting for a day each month, and The Alternative Board runs monthly advisory boards in Milton Keynes. at.theboard circles is smaller, five men, with every member on the whiteboard every month, a walk built into each session, and a fixed twelve-month circle.

### How do I join?

Start with a free Whiteboard Session with John on whatever is live in your business. The free Whiteboard Session is open to anyone. A place in a circle is not. If a circle is right for you, you go on a waiting list until John can place you in one where nobody does what you do. The first circle is being selected now.

[How at.theboard circles compares with the other options in Milton Keynes](https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/business-groups-milton-keynes)

## Location

In person at the Shire Retreat, Milton Keynes. Online between sessions. Members will come from across Milton Keynes and the surrounding area.

## How to join

Online, or in person in Milton Keynes. Your choice.

### It goes on the whiteboard

Whatever is live this week, in your words, not the tidy version.

### You leave with something to do

We stay with it until it has a shape and something you can act on Monday.

### No pitch afterwards

Free whether you join or not. No follow-up sequence.

I say what I think as we go rather than saving it up for the end. That includes telling you if what you have is a process problem rather than a judgement one. If it is, I will say so and send you off to fix the process. That happens, and it costs me the work, which is fine.

Book a Whiteboard Session: https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/board#book

# Catalyst Growth Coaching, home page

# Strategic thinking, out loud, at a whiteboard. Another mind in the room with you. For senior leaders.

Executive coaching for senior leaders in London and Milton Keynes.

> We think it through together. The words go up on the board. And quickly, it starts to make sense.

Big challenges or small ones. Most of them come back to people, what they’re capable of, and the politics in between.

Nothing in your week is designed for thinking.

Meetings are designed for decisions. Email is designed for response. The calendar is designed for time-blocking. Your assistant is designed for protection.

Every system around you is optimising for output. None of them are optimising for thought.

The result: you make decisions in the cracks. You arrive at the most important meeting of your quarter without having actually sat with the question. You leave the most expensive moments of your week to be navigated by reflex.

Whiteboard Sessions are the thing the rest of your week is incompatible with.

## A Whiteboard Session is what it sounds like, with one thing the name doesn't tell you. You're not thinking alone.

You arrive. The board is empty. We start with whatever's actually live for you, and we think it through together, out loud, until it's clear. I'm not there to watch you work. I'm the other mind in the room, asking the question you'd stopped asking, catching the thing you've gone blind to because you see it every day.

Sometimes that takes an hour. Sometimes three. The work is finished when the question is answered, when the next move is clear, the decision made.

Your thinking, out of your head, onto the board, into a solution.

## Three things, mostly.

The strategic question you've been carrying without having sat with. The thing you keep meaning to think about but haven't.

The problem in the middle that's stuck. Where the system is producing the wrong output and you can't see where the leverage is.

The tactical decision you've been over-thinking. Where you know what to do but haven't given yourself permission to do it.

These are the three levels: the big picture, the middle, and the day to day. Most weeks have at least one of them building up. We find which one needs the work, and we think it through together.

Working with John has been transformative. I came in overwhelmed and stuck; I left with a clear structure for how I lead and make decisions under pressure.

Working with John has given me renewed focus and confidence at a point in my career when I really needed it. The CliftonStrengths work was the most clarifying thing I have done professionally.

I just wish I had met John years ago. The frameworks he uses would have saved me from expensive mistakes in two previous businesses.

Who John is Fifteen years across organisational consulting and executive coaching. Gallup certified in CliftonStrengths and a FITT16 practitioner, the 16-type profile built from it. [The credentials in full](https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/about)

Who John works with Alongside the organisations above, individual leaders coached from AWS, Volkswagen Financial Services, Nexans and Bassett Mechanical, among others, across industries and countries. [What the work looks like in the room](https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/in-practice)

## Two kinds of leader. Same practice.

The fastest way to know if this is for you is to be at the board for an hour.

You'll know whether the practice fits you.

One hour. No charge, nothing to prepare.

# One-to-one business coaching for owners, online and in Milton Keynes

## Get your business where it is going, sooner.

Six months, one owner, one whiteboard.

Several decisions settled in every session, each with an action and a date, and every one checked next time.

One-to-one coaching for business owners, men and women. Online or in Milton Keynes, £600 a month plus VAT, starting with a free Whiteboard Session with me, John Obidipe.

An hour on something real in your business. No pitch at the end.

## You run the business. Some weeks it runs you.

For owners of businesses with roughly 5 to 25 staff and £250k to £5m turnover, men and women. Smaller businesses are welcome to talk to me.

### “Some weeks I am flying. Other weeks I can barely get going.”

### “I get stuck on one problem and everything else slows down behind it.”

### “I have been sitting on the same decision for months and it is costing me.”

### “I know the next step matters, I just cannot see it clearly from inside the business.”

### “I am still the person who closes every sale, and growth stops when I stop.”

### “I am good at what I do. I am less sure I am good at running the thing I built.”

> If two or more of those sound like something you have said to yourself late at night, the free Whiteboard Session is worth taking.

## Out of your head and onto the whiteboard

Each session runs for 90 minutes.

### Everything goes up (Your call)

Whatever is live that fortnight: a hire, a price, a client, a plan you keep putting off. All of it, so nothing stays in your head.

### We work through each one (Questions first)

I ask questions first, so the thinking on the whiteboard is yours. Then I give you my honest view.

### You leave with actions and dates (Every session)

Several decisions made, each with an action you can take before we next meet and a date against it.

### Next time, we check every one (Nothing slips)

What is done gets ticked. What no longer matters gets closed. The focus stays on what will move the business.

Online, with the whiteboard shared live on screen. If you are local to Milton Keynes, we can meet in person instead.

## Real owners, real decisions

Short films of owners who have worked at the whiteboard with me. Tap to play with sound.

## Six things I commit to before we start

### Outcomes you can measure

We agree two or three results at the start, such as a number, a hire made or a day back in your week, and check them at three months and at the end.

### One fixed price

You know the full cost on day one, and you can stop at the midpoint and pay only for the half you used.

### Several decisions every session

No session ends on a good conversation. Each one ends with several decisions on the whiteboard, each with your name and a date against it. You leave with clarity and commitment.

### Nothing slips

Every action is checked at the next session. Anything no longer relevant is closed, so the focus stays on what moves the needle.

### My honest view

I ask first, and then I tell you what I think, including when it is not what you hoped to hear.

### A fixed end date

By the last session you can run this kind of thinking on your own, without me in the room. Many enjoy it so much they choose to keep going.

> What you bring stays between us.

One hour is enough to know whether this is for you.

## Six months, one price, published

- Length: Six months, with a fixed end date
- Rhythm: One session a fortnight, 12 in total
- Session length: 90 minutes
- Where: Online, or in person in Milton Keynes
- Price: £600 a month, £3,600 for the six months, plus VAT
- Stopping early: Stop at three months and pay £1,800 plus VAT
- Included: CliftonStrengths assessment and debrief at the start
- Who it is for: Business owners, men and women
- Way in: A free Whiteboard Session, with no pitch at the end

If after the Whiteboard Session this is not the right fit, I will say so and point you somewhere better.

## Where the one-to-one can lead

### The circles

For men who want to keep pushing after six months: a circle of five owner-managers who meet twice a month for twelve months, with a turn at the whiteboard every month.

[About the circles](https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/board)

### Succession planning

One-to-one coaching for your second in command, so the business runs without you. For the person who could keep things running when you are not there, such as an operations manager or a trusted senior team member. Six sessions with me over three months, so more of the decisions that land on your desk can stop with them. £1,800 plus VAT.

### TeamStrong

When the change has to reach your whole team: six months with you, each team member one to one, and the team together.

[About TeamStrong](https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/teamstrong)

## John Obidipe

I am John Obidipe. I spent years as a senior business analyst and transformation specialist before coaching, so I am at home with a P&L, a process map and a difficult conversation.

I have worked with owners running firms of £250k to £5m and with leaders inside Toyota, Convatec and the University of Oxford. I am Gallup-certified in CliftonStrengths and a FITT16 practitioner.

[The credentials in full](https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/about)

## What owners ask before they start

### Is this only for men?

No. The one-to-one is for any business owner. The circles are men only, and that is the only part of at.theboard that is.

### What if I do not know what to bring?

That is common. The first session starts with where the business is heading and what is in the way, and the decisions show up quickly from there.

### Is this consulting?

Not in the usual sense. I do not take your problem away and come back with a report. We think your challenges through together at the whiteboard, and I make suggestions drawn from my experience of working with small and large businesses. The decision is always yours.

### How is this different from a business coach I have tried before?

Every session ends with several decisions, each with an action and a date, and every one is checked next time. The price and end date are fixed from day one, and you can stop halfway if it is not working.

### How much does it cost?

£600 a month plus VAT for six months, £3,600 in total, or £1,800 if you stop at three months.

### Is it online or in person?

Online by default, with the whiteboard shared live on screen. Owners local to Milton Keynes can meet in person.

### Can I move into a circle afterwards?

Yes, if you are a man and a place suits you. Men who apply have a session at the whiteboard first and then join the waiting list for the right circle.

## Bring one real thing to the whiteboard

The free Whiteboard Session is exactly what it sounds like.

You bring whatever is pressing in your business, we work it through at the whiteboard, and you leave with your next step written down. If we both think there is more to do, we talk about the six months. If not, you still have the hour.

### It goes on the whiteboard

Whatever is live this week, in your words, not the tidy version.

### You leave with something to do

We stay with it until it has a shape and something you can act on Monday.

### No pitch afterwards

Free whether you carry on or not. No follow-up sequence.

Book a Whiteboard Session: https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/board/one-to-one#book

# Good is where your leaders are. It is not where they have to stop, on their own or together.

TeamStrong is work with a leadership team of five to ten, at your venue or ours at the Shire Retreat, Milton Keynes: one high impact day, or six months with a session each month. The Day is from £3,500 plus VAT.

Some leadership teams run the business together. Others are a group of leaders who each run their own part of it and come together to report. Both can grow, in different ways. Choose the one that sounds like you.

## We run the business together.

You share the decisions and the outcomes, and you want to work as one.

[For teams who work as one](https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/teamstrong/one-team)

## We each run our own area.

You lead your own region, function or division, and you want every leader to grow in how they lead it.

[For leaders who run their own area](https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/teamstrong/leaders)

## In the room with leadership teams

## Start with a conversation

Tell me about your leaders and what you would like to see change. A short conversation is enough to work out whether the One Day Programme, the Six Month Programme or neither is the right fit.

<!-- canonical: https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/teamstrong/one-team -->

# “Everyone around the table is capable. We still do not work as one.”

For leadership teams of five to ten who share the decisions, the pressure and the outcomes. I find out how your team really works, through the lens that suits you best. Then we work through what it shows you, at the board, until it changes how you lead together.

## You know this team is better than it performs

> “We agree in the meeting, and by Thursday nothing has moved.”

> “I know who is strongest at what. I am not sure they do.”

> “We are polite with each other, and I think the politeness is costing us.”

> “Some days I am sure it is that person over there. Other days I wonder if it is me.”

## There is more than one way to see how a team really works

Ask a leadership team how they work together and you will hear how they would like to work. To see how they actually work, you need to look from the outside, through more than one lens, and I choose the one that fits your team. Whichever we use, every session looks at both sides: how the team works together, and how its leader shows up.

## One day your team will still be talking about months later

A single, high impact day at your venue or ours at the Shire Retreat, Milton Keynes, in the setting you choose. Each leads to the same place: a clear, shared picture of how you really work as a team, and two or three changes you agree before you leave.

### The immersive building experience.

A team building experience that everyone takes part in. On a mini construction site with real small diggers and machines, six metres by three and brought to your venue, your team plans and builds together through competitions and activities. Along the way we talk about how you communicate, how you plan, who takes ownership and how you work with each other.

Site footage coming soon.

### The board.

We harness the creativity and problem solving of the whole group, live at the whiteboard. It gives your team the chance to nail down solutions to problems that have been running for a while, and I guide you to set out plans to put those solutions into action and test them.

### The strengths lens.

When cohesion and collaboration are the focus, you need to go beyond skin deep. Everyone completes FITT16 and CliftonStrengths beforehand, so team members understand each other at a deep level, work more productively together and head off conflict before it starts.

From £3,500 plus VAT, depending on the size of your team. One price for your team, agreed up front, with everything included.

## When we want lasting change

One high impact session a month, each in a different setting, so the team keeps moving. The mix is chosen for your team. A typical shape:

- Month one, the immersive building experience.The team as it is today.
- Month two, the strengths lens.Why it works that way.
- Months three to five, the board.Real decisions, worked through together, with actions and dates checked each month.
- Month six, back to the immersive building experience.The same task, the same team, and a very different result.

The leader has their own one-to-one sessions alongside. Price agreed with each team.

## Questions

### What space does the immersive building experience need?

Two areas side by side: one for the immersive building experience, which is six metres by three, and one for horseshoe seating where we talk. It works indoors or outdoors, and the machines are self-powered, so no power is needed.

### What if someone would rather not drive the machines?

That is fine. There is plenty to do without driving, and planning the task is often where the most revealing conversations happen.

### What is included in the price?

Everything. The One Day Programme is one price for the whole package, immersive building experience included, from £3,500 plus VAT depending on numbers. For the Six Month Programme, we agree one price before we start, and it includes the one-to-one sessions.

### Do we have to do the immersive building experience?

No. The immersive building experience is one of three settings, alongside the board and the strengths lens. We choose together what suits your team.

## Start with a conversation

Tell me about your team and what you would like to see change. A short conversation is enough to work out whether the One Day Programme, the Six Month Programme or neither is the right fit.

Book a conversation: https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/teamstrong/one-team#book

# “We spend the meeting on the numbers. The real story is in how we lead.”

For leadership teams of five to ten where each leader runs their own region, function or division. You are not trying to become one team. Each of you is growing in how you lead your own people, and you are doing it alongside each other.

## Everyone reports on their team. Nobody reports on themselves.

### If you sit around the table

> “I know exactly how my numbers are doing. I am less sure how I am doing.”

> “My team takes its lead from me. I am not always sure what it is taking.”

> “I can see what is not working in my area. I am less sure how much of it starts with me.”

### If you lead the leaders, or look after them

> “Some of my leaders are further along than others. We all know it, and nobody says it.”

> “I want every one of my leaders to grow, each at their own level. This is how I invest in all of them at once, and nobody is singled out.”

## A clearer view of how each of you leads

It is hard to see how you lead from inside your own area. So we step outside it together and look from a different angle, one that shows each of you how you come across to the people who report to you. Each leader leaves knowing what they want to change.

## One day, and every leader takes something back to their team

A single, high impact day at your venue or ours at the Shire Retreat, Milton Keynes, in the setting you choose. Each leader leaves with a clear picture of how they show up, and two or three changes to take back to their own team.

### The immersive building experience.

A team building experience that every leader takes part in. On a mini construction site with real small diggers and machines, six metres by three and brought to your venue, you plan and build together through competitions and activities. Each leader’s habits show up quickly, and we talk about how you communicate, how you plan, who takes ownership and how you work with others.

Site footage coming soon.

### The board.

Each leader brings a live problem from their own area, and we harness the creativity and problem solving of the whole group, live at the whiteboard. Problems that have been running for a while get solved, and I guide each leader to set out a plan to put the solution into action and test it.

### The strengths lens.

When cohesion and collaboration are the focus, you need to go beyond skin deep. Everyone completes FITT16 and CliftonStrengths beforehand, so each leader understands the others at a deep level, and sees what their own way of leading means for the people who report to them.

From £3,500 plus VAT, depending on the size of your team. One price for your team, agreed up front, with everything included.

## Each leader growing, month by month

One high impact session a month, each in a different setting, so the growth keeps moving and has time to show up in each leader’s own team. The mix is chosen for your leaders. A typical shape:

- Month one, the immersive building experience.How each of you leads today.
- Month two, the strengths lens.Why you lead that way.
- Months three to five, the board.Real challenges from each area, with actions and dates checked each month.
- Month six, back to the immersive building experience.The same task, and a clear view of how each of you has changed.

Leaders can have their own one-to-one sessions alongside where it helps. Price agreed with each team.

## Questions

### What space does the immersive building experience need?

Two areas side by side: one for the immersive building experience, which is six metres by three, and one for horseshoe seating where we talk. It works indoors or outdoors, and the machines are self-powered, so no power is needed.

### What if someone would rather not drive the machines?

That is fine. There is plenty to do without driving, and planning the task is often where the most revealing conversations happen.

### What is included in the price?

Everything. The One Day Programme is one price for the whole package, immersive building experience included, from £3,500 plus VAT depending on numbers. For the Six Month Programme, we agree one price before we start, and it includes the one-to-one sessions.

### Our leaders do not work together day to day. Will this still work?

Yes, that is exactly who this page is for. The aim is not to make you one team. It is for each leader to see how they lead their own people, with the others alongside.

## Start with a conversation

Tell me about your leaders and what you would like to see grow. A short conversation is enough to work out whether the One Day Programme, the Six Month Programme or neither is the right fit.

Book a conversation: https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/teamstrong/leaders#book

<!-- canonical: https://catalystgrowthcoach.co.uk/mdsvp -->

# Everyone around the table is capable. You want to be the one whose judgement they trust.

One-to-one coaching at an online whiteboard for vice presidents in medical device companies who are ready for the next seat, whether that is general manager, a regional leadership role or the executive committee. I currently work with senior leaders at Convatec, Urgo and Becton Dickinson.

## You are trusted to deliver. You want to be trusted to decide.

“At this level performance is assumed. What people notice now is how I think when the pressure is on.”

“Global wants delivery, my directors want answers, and there are very few people I can think out loud with.”

“When a restructure or a portfolio call goes against my region, I keep everyone steady and carry the cost quietly.”

“Too much still comes back to me. I want directors who grow the business without needing me in every decision.”

“Most of what I have tried on leadership was written for people earlier in their careers than I am.”

“I spend so much time on this quarter that the thinking about the next five years keeps getting pushed back.”

## Leading at the level you know you are capable of

You want a seat where your decisions shape the direction of the business, and a reputation in the executive room as someone whose view is sought before the decision is made. You want a bench of directors strong enough that the growth in your region comes from the leaders you have developed as much as from the deals they close. And you want enough clear space to think about where the business is going, so that this quarter informs your decisions without running them.

## There’s nothing wrong with you. It is complicated.

Everybody knows the answer. Manage up. Think strategically. Delegate more. Knowing it was never the problem. Four things get in the way of doing it.

“The thinking about the next five years keeps losing to this quarter.”

Your week belongs to everyone else: global reviews, board papers, your directors’ escalations. The question that matters most sits at the back of your mind for months.

The session is that hour. One fixed slot a week, online, wherever you are that week. You bring what is already live, so it is not extra work. You leave with decisions made and actions agreed. No homework.

“If I let go of the detail and the region misses, it’s my name on it.”

You do not let go all at once. We build a considered plan to hand over one responsibility at a time , at a pace your directors can absorb, with a clear check so you still see the number every week.

Each handover frees space in your diary. Then we protect it. A vice president’s list never ends, so before each handover you decide what the freed hours are for, and the thinking the next seat asks of you goes in first. Anything new at your current level goes to a director, or waits.

Underneath is a fear: that the one thing you let go will be the thing that counts against you. So nothing is dropped in private. You agree with your boss what is being parked, so it is a shared decision, not a gamble. And we test the fear: what did you let go last time, and what actually happened? People are promoted for their judgement about what matters , not for doing everything.

“I know how to influence. I don’t know how to influence this executive team.”

Doing it depends on your situation: your president, your peers, global, your history with each of them. Sometimes you are navigating complex personality dynamics. Sometimes it is politics. That is why it has not been easy to go from the LinkedIn article you read, or the executive programme you went on, to actually doing it.

You need to talk your own situation through to find the move that works there. That is what we do in our sessions. Sometimes we use the whiteboard to really work it through. Sometimes it is as simple as talking.

“The more senior I get, the fewer people tell me the truth.”

Your directors will not say. Your boss sees you twice a month. Your peers want the same seat you do. Without honest feedback you cannot adjust.

I tell you plainly, and kindly, how you come across , including when you are the problem. And we find one trusted person at work you can ask after the meetings that matter.

## Your thinking, out of your head and onto an online whiteboard

Each session starts with whatever is live for you that week, whether that is a board presentation, a difficult director, a portfolio decision or the role you are working towards. It all goes up on the whiteboard, and we work through each issue until you leave with decisions made and actions agreed. At the next session we check every one, so nothing slips.

I ask questions first. Often the answer is already in your thinking, and when it isn't, I'll help you get to it. When it helps, I give you my honest view as well. Most sessions run online, with the whiteboard shared live on your screen. In person works too, and where a company wants it, I travel to the team.

## The online whiteboard

### Join from your laptop.

A video call from wherever you are that week: the office, a hotel, between meetings or across time zones.

### The board, shared live.

I write on the whiteboard as you talk, shared live on your screen, so you see the whole of it take shape.

### Decisions before we finish.

Every session still ends with decisions made and actions agreed, on the board and checked next time.

### You keep the board.

After each session you get a copy of the finished board, so the thinking does not stay in the call.

## Strong results, and the next role still feels a step away

“When my VP asks where the business should go, I hear myself answering with the forecast.”

“My managers bring every difficult decision to me, so I never have time to think beyond this quarter.”

“Global wants certainty, the NHS accounts want more value for less money, and I am the one holding it together.”

“I am good at keeping everything steady. I am less sure that is what gets people promoted.”

“I have done the leadership programme. It explained the theory but did not change how I handle a Tuesday when everything lands at once.”

“I want the VP role, and I want to be ready before it is offered.”

## Stepping into vice president ready

You want to walk into the VP role already leading at that level, with a team of managers who make good decisions without you and a reputation as someone who thinks about the whole business. You want the confidence to put your own view on the table first, in front of your VP and the global team, and to have it taken seriously. And you want to close the gap between how you are seen today and the leader you know you can be.

## There’s nothing wrong with you. It is complicated.
